harness.note: the real result entry and handler over the real command table; the battle RNG is scripted (in.draws are the raw values it returned), the per-target recalculation is a recorder. An independent Python model agreed on every exported vector.

description: The hits an Overdrive result removes: the pending hits per target before and after, the target mask, the draws taken and their stream.
notes: in.cmd is the command id, in.cat its category byte (Cmd+0x58), in.menuHits its hit count (Cmd+0x2b); in.replHits/in.replRandom are the replacement record's hit count and random-target flag (0 when the handler never reads one).

in.pending is [character, hits still to land] in ascending character order; out.pending the same after the removal; out.mask the target mask the handler wrote; out.streams the streams of the draws it took.
in.draws is cut to the draws the handler took plus one.
name: overdrive_removal
